{{Quote|The Tomb of Hakagram Graush remained silent to my queries.|Darth Plagueis|<ref name="Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>}}
The '''Tomb of Hakagram Graush''' was a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] mausoleum located on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]. It was the final resting place of the late [[King/Legends|King]] [[Hakagram Graush]], around the year [[6900 BBY]]. [[Millennium/Legends|Millennia]] later, [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] entered Graush's tomb in hopes of facing a [[Force ghost/Legends|Sith spirit]]. Apparently, Plagueis encountered no ghost in this tomb, to his great disappointment.<ref name="Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side" />
